Yes, please go ahead and start building this. The behaviors we've walked through all match what I had in my head — saving a link and having it fill in on its own, being able to fix the wording, not ending up with duplicates, finding things by searching and by my own labels, the read-later pile, tucking things away in the archive versus really deleting them, doing things to a batch at once, and all the sensible handling for empty screens, errors, and those edge cases. I feel good about the whole picture.

And I'm content with keeping the "saved copy of the page" idea on the list for a later round rather than stuffing it into this build — I just wanted it firmly on the record, and it sounds like it is.

One thing I'll say, not to change today's scope but so it's not a surprise when I see the real thing: what matters to me is that all of this actually works together on my real collection, not just in the individual demos — that my searching, my labels, my read-later and archive states, and my sorting of the list all hold up once I've got a good number of bookmarks in there. When you bring back the finished app, that's what I'll be looking at. Go for it.
